map.📏 腰围正确测量方法: 📏 How to measure your waist correctly
map.1. 空腹或餐后2小时测量: 1. Measure on an empty stomach or 2 hours after a meal
map.2. 身体直立，自然呼吸，不要收腹或鼓腹: 2. Stand upright and breathe naturally; do not suck in or push out your belly
map.3. 软尺经肚脐水平绕腰一周: 3. Wrap the tape horizontally around your waist at the navel
map.4. 软尺紧贴皮肤但不压迫软组织: 4. Keep the tape against the skin without pressing into the soft tissue
map.5. 在呼气末读数，精确到0.1cm: 5. Read at the end of an exhale, to the nearest 0.1 cm

map.为什么腰臀比比 BMI 更能反映风险？: Why does waist-to-hip ratio reflect risk better than BMI?
map.BMI 不区分脂肪分布，而腹部（内脏）脂肪与代谢疾病关系更密切。同样 BMI 的: BMI does not distinguish fat distribution, whereas abdominal (visceral) fat is more closely linked to metabolic disease. Among people with the same BMI, the apple shape (abdominal obesity) carries higher risk than the pear shape, and WHR/WHtR captures this.
map.量腰围的正确位置？: Where is the correct position to measure the waist?
map.站立、自然呼吸，软尺绕肚脐上方约 1-2cm（或肋骨下缘与髂嵴中点）水平一周，取: Stand and breathe naturally, wrap the tape horizontally about 1-2 cm above the navel (or at the midpoint between the lower rib and the iliac crest), read at the end of an exhale and do not hold your breath or suck in your belly. Measure the hip at the widest point horizontally.
